requirements.description: User requires an energy class C or better, so all classes from A1 to C are accepted. Location, transport access, floor area, and capacity are outside the energy-efficiency scope and are not filtered here.
User asks for proximity to public transport. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71).

The building will be converted into a university student residence, so proximity to universities and schools is clearly necessary. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14, rounded to 75).

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 850. The 60-person capacity is not converted to an area threshold because no verified gross-property-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. Energy class and public transport proximity are not reference columns and are ignored.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND surface_area >= 850 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on property type (offices), energy class A1–C, surface area ≥ 850 sqm, a 3.0 km radius around the supplied coordinates, mobility ≥ 71 and education ≥ 75. Ordered by distance from the center point. The clauses are listed from strictest to softest. The requests for capacity of 60 people and the CDP/PNRR program are not in the extracted requirements, so they are not applied.
